_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record. For each submitted link: the intended ASIN and the official listing URL that the site publishes, the date and source of that confirmation, and the observed redirect target recorded separately. The two fields are never merged. Amazon defines the ASIN as the checkable product identifier; the short-link path code is not an ASIN.
_meta.tracking_id_source: Supplied by the site owner on 2026-11-17 in the brief. Format check: Amazon's help page at https://www.amazon.com/b?ie=UTF8&node=51812349011 (read 2026-11-17) states that Amazon's software adds '-20' to Store IDs and that a US Store ID ends in -20. The ID has not been verified as active in Associates Central.
_meta.method: fetch of each short link (follow redirects) and of each official listing page; ASIN read from the final URL path; title and category breadcrumb read from the page. Not verified: any Associates reporting, any commission category (F-01).
_meta.reconciliation_2026_11_17: Merge reconciliation (arena/1f4a7a22-zone4): decisions D-01/D-14 (recorded 2026-11-17 under the owner's brief) publish the tagged Special Links as the outbound product hrefs, so published_outbound_url now equals tracking_id_candidate_url for P1-P3. The parallel data/link-intent.json was withdrawn as a duplicate of this record; its append-only redirect-history observations (2026-11-14, 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 reads, each citing its session record) are preserved in observed_redirect_history. The short links remain recorded verbatim and are not judged valid or invalid (Zone3 FLG-003 unresolved). Attribution is unverified until the Associates Central one-link-per-product test passes (F-57, F-58).
_meta.asin_format_source: Amazon's published ASIN guide: https://sell.amazon.com/blog/what-is-an-asin (read 2026-11-17, arena/cc32105d-zone4): an ASIN is a unique 10-character alphanumeric code that appears after /dp/ in the product URL and typically starts 'B0'. The submitted link path codes are nine characters and appear in the short-link path, so they are not ASINs (flag F-67).
_meta.reconciliation_2026_11_19: 2026-11-19 (arena/4cfacb30-zone4): P4 and P5 were re-resolved from their submitted short links. Each opened to the ASIN recorded here, so the intended-ASIN fields are confirmed against the official listing page. Under decision D-46 both candidates are published as tagged Special Links with the same status as P1-P3. The earlier 2026-11-17 reads are kept in observed_redirect_history.
